```c
// AUTO-GENERATED outer-tiled MX matmul baseline (41x512x512).
// Optimized: fast-path (full blocks, pad=0) vs slow-path (partial boundary block).
void solution(void) {
  int tiles   = BLK / DIM;
  int tiles_K = MATMUL_K / DIM;

  uint32_t a_base   = 0;
  uint32_t b_base   = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tiles * tiles_K * DIM;
  int      SPAD_DEST = 128;

  // Boundary tile indices: only i0==last_i0 can be a partial M-block.
  // REAL_N=512 is assumed to be an exact multiple of BLK, so last_j0 is always full.
  int last_i0 = (REAL_M - 1) / BLK;
  int last_j0 = (REAL_N - 1) / BLK;

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // FAST PATH: all full (i0, j0) blocks — pad_i==0, pad_j==0 guaranteed.
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  for (int i0 = 0; i0 < last_i0; i0++) {
    for (int j0 = 0; j0 <= last_j0; j0++) {
      // Stage per-group scales for this (i0,j0) block.
      for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++) {
        memcpy(&A_s[g][0], &A_scales_row[g][i0 * BLK], BLK);
        memcpy(&B_s[g][0], &B_scales_col[g][j0 * BLK], BLK);
      }

      // --- Programming model sequence ---
      gemmini_flush(0);
      gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY,
                                  1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);

      // Load scales: sel=0 -> A (activation), sel=1 -> B (weight).
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)A_s, A_S_BYTES, 0);
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)B_s, B_S_BYTES, 1);

      // MVIN A tiles (stride = full K row of elem_t).
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t));
      for (int i = 0; i < tiles; i++)
        for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++)
          gemmini_extended_mvin(
            (void*)(((elem_t*)A_in) + (i0 * BLK + i * DIM) * MATMUL_K + k * DIM),
            a_base + (i * tiles_K + k) * DIM,
            DIM, DIM);

      // MVIN B tiles (stride = full N row of elem_t).
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t));
      for (int j = 0; j < tiles; j++)
        for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++)
          gemmini_extended_mvin(
            (void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + (k * DIM) * MATMUL_N + (j0 * BLK + j * DIM)),
            b_base + (k * tiles + j) * DIM,
            DIM, DIM);

      // Configure output / requantizer (tile bounds must match loop_ws_spad).
      gemmini_config_st(BLK_OUTC * sizeof(out_t));
      gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors,
                                   tiles, tiles, tiles_K,
                                   0, 0, 1);

      // Compute: pad_i=0, pad_j=0 hardcoded for full blocks.
      gemmini_loop_ws_spad(tiles, tiles, tiles_K,
                           /*pad_I*/0, /*pad_J*/0, /*pad_K*/0,
                           a_base, BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS, 0, SPAD_DEST,
                           false, false, false, false, false,
                           NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);

      // Drain results: mrows==BLK for the fast path.
      for (int r = 0; r < BLK; r++)
        gemmini_mx_read_smem(
          &C_hw[i0 * BLK + r][(j0 * BLK) / BF16_PER_WORD],
          SPAD_DEST * 16 + r * BLK,
          BLK);   // ncols==BLK guaranteed
      gemmini_fence();
    }
  }

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // SLOW PATH: the single partial M boundary block (i0 == last_i0) and all
  // j0 columns.  N=512 is assumed exact, so pad_j==0 throughout.
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  {
    int i0 = last_i0;
    for (int j0 = 0; j0 <= last_j0; j0++) {
      int mrows = REAL_M - i0 * BLK;
      if (mrows > BLK) mrows = BLK;
      if (mrows <= 0) continue;

      int ncols = REAL_N - j0 * BLK;
      if (ncols > BLK) ncols = BLK;
      if (ncols <= 0) continue;

      int pad_i = BLK - mrows;
      int pad_j = BLK - ncols;

      // Stage per-group scales for this (i0,j0) block.
      for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++) {
        memcpy(&A_s[g][0], &A_scales_row[g][i0 * BLK], BLK);
        memcpy(&B_s[g][0], &B_scales_col[g][j0 * BLK], BLK);
      }

      // --- Programming model sequence ---
      gemmini_flush(0);
      gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY,
                                  1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);

      // Load scales: sel=0 -> A (activation), sel=1 -> B (weight).
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)A_s, A_S_BYTES, 0);
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)B_s, B_S_BYTES, 1);

      // MVIN A tiles.
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t));
      for (int i = 0; i < tiles; i++)
        for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++)
          gemmini_extended_mvin(
            (void*)(((elem_t*)A_in) + (i0 * BLK + i * DIM) * MATMUL_K + k * DIM),
            a_base + (i * tiles_K + k) * DIM,
            DIM, DIM);

      // MVIN B tiles.
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t));
      for (int j = 0; j < tiles; j++)
        for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++)
          gemmini_extended_mvin(
            (void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + (k * DIM) * MATMUL_N + (j0 * BLK + j * DIM)),
            b_base + (k * tiles + j) * DIM,
            DIM, DIM);

      // Configure output / requantizer.
      gemmini_config_st(BLK_OUTC * sizeof(out_t));
      gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors,
                                   tiles, tiles, tiles_K,
                                   0, 0, 1);

      // Compute with actual padding values.
      gemmini_loop_ws_spad(tiles, tiles, tiles_K,
                           pad_i, pad_j, 0,
                           a_base, BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS, 0, SPAD_DEST,
                           false, false, false, false, false,
                           NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);

      // Drain only the real (non-padded) rows.
      for (int r = 0; r < mrows; r++)
        gemmini_mx_read_smem(
          &C_hw[i0 * BLK + r][(j0 * BLK) / BF16_PER_WORD],
          SPAD_DEST * 16 + r * BLK,
          ncols);
      gemmini_fence();
    }
  }
}
```
